notes.title: In The Shadows 1.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Easier puzzle completion
[*] Out of Bounds / Clipping fixes (thanks to @Astarius youtube clips)
[*] Minor changes into the interaction widget to make the hint text more obvious and clear
[/list]

notes.title: Regarding the difficulty of the puzzles
notes.notes: I've had many returns regarding how hard the puzzles can be and I've heard it. I will work on a small update to further refine the movement system of the puzzles, and make them easier to achieve. Stay tuned !

notes.title: In The Shadows 1.1 - Fixes and more
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Input system rethought to be easier to handle
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get Out Of Bounds
[*] Added achievements to the game
[*] Added soundtrack as paid DLC
[/list]
